stem: In which year were there more girls than boys enrolled?
hints: Compare the Boys and Girls numbers on the same row, one year at a time.
You want the row where the Girls number is bigger than the Boys number.
Check all five years. Remember that when two numbers are equal, neither one is more.

solution.methodName: Read the title and units, then find the row and column

steps.action: 2025: boys 500, girls 500. Equal, so not more girls.
steps.why: "More than" means bigger. 500 is not more than 500.

steps.action: Only in 2023 were there more girls than boys.

trapNotes.2021: In 2021 there were more boys (420) than girls (380). You may have compared the columns the wrong way round.
trapNotes.2024: The numbers are close, but in 2024 there were 480 boys and only 470 girls.
trapNotes.2025: In 2025, girls and boys are equal (500 each). Equal is not more.
